How it works

Three steps. No typing.

01

Tap the mic

Say what you ate the way you'd tell a friend. "Medium fry from McDonald's." "Pasta with red sauce, big bowl."

02

We resolve it

Agentic search hits the chain menus first, USDA for plain food, web + PDFs for everything else. Real macros, not guesses.

03

Logged in seconds

Calorie ring updates, macros tick up, Apple Health syncs. Ask the coach what to eat next.

Just say what you ate.
